messages:
Alex: Cutting a release candidate now from branch release/3.2.x. Tagging as candidate-v3.2.0-rc1. Please review pin matrix and sign off for canary rollout.
Priya: Thanks Alex. Outline the canary plan and rollback steps here?
Alex: Canary plan: 1% for 15m, then 10% for 30m, then 50% for 15m, then full. Watchers: eng-oncall, perf, infra. Rollback: immediate revert to candidate-v3.2.0-rc0 (previous stable), or route traffic to dedicated fallback model endpoint.
Sam: Quick note — I pinned transformers to 4.28.0 in the candidate (see diff). That avoids the inference kernel mismatch we saw last week.
Kara: Confirming smoke test matrix queued: auth flows, streaming latency, kv-cache warmup, token billing sanity. I kicked off the smoke job.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] candidate-build created: candidate-v3.2.0-rc1 by Alex. Build URL: https://ci.redwood/1234/jobs/5678. Commit: 9f8b6a1
Alex: Commit sha: 9f8b6a1
```
git tag candidate-v3.2.0-rc1 9f8b6a1
git push origin candidate-v3.2.0-rc1
```
Priya: I reviewed the release notes draft in the PR and added the observability section. Suggest calling out the KV cache prewarm change as a breaking perf tweak for long-lived streams.
Morgan: I ran the end-to-end on the dedicated stack. Latency p90 improved ~5ms, overall QPS unchanged. No auth regressions.
Sam: Smoke job passed for infra and auth, failing a flaky test in perf/eval (non-blocking for canary). Tagging it flaky in the suite.
Kara: Marking canary start window: 2026-03-21T01:00:00Z (change window: 2h). Ops aware.
Priya: Approving canary from product -- minor UX change noted but non-blocking. :thumbsup:
Alex: Approve from eng/serving: I sign off on kernel selection and quantization profile.
Sam: Approve from eng-ml: model variant validated on sample prompts.
Kara: Approve from eng-sre: monitoring hooks are in place, alert thresholds set.
release-bot: [release-bot] Sign-off summary captured. Approvals: Priya, Alex, Sam, Kara. Ready for canary.
Alex: Starting canary rollout now. Will monitor dashboards and add brief updates.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Starting canary promotion: candidate-v3.2.0-rc1 -> staging-canary. Step: 1% traffic. Link: https://deploy.redwood/canary/7890
Kara: Canary 1% in, dashboards look clean so far. No error spike.
15m passed
Kara: Advancing to 10% after 15m.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary traffic updated: 10%
Sam: Perf team ran trace sampling at 10%, nothing alarming. A couple of tail requests noted, investigating but likely unrelated.
Kara: After 30m at 10% we saw stable metrics. Moving to 50%.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary traffic updated: 50%
Priya: Quick reminder: release notes will ship with the deploy; final paragraph includes instructions for partners to opt into the new quantized variant.
Alex: All checks green. No regression alerts in the last 45m. Recommend promotion to prod at the end of the change window.
Morgan: Ops: I'll keep rollback command ready. Quick rollback snippet if needed:
```
kubectl set image deploy/inference inference=image:candidate-v3.2.0-rc0 -n prod
# or use traffic router
curl -X POST https://router.redwood/shift -d '{"route":"fallback","percentage":100}'
```
Kara: We have a 15-min hold for final ops review.
Kara: Hold expired. Final sign-offs confirmed.
Alex: Promoting to prod now.
release-bot: [release-bot] Promotion started by Alex: candidate-v3.2.0-rc1 -> production.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion step: 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m checks between.
Kara: Noting the migration window: 02:00-04:00 local infra uplift scheduled.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion update: 25% complete.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion update: 50% complete.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion update: 100% complete.
release-bot: [release-bot] Promotion complete. candidate-v3.2.0-rc1 is now live in production. Release notes: https://notes.redwood/release/3.2.0
Alex: Tagging release in changelog and notifying docs to publish the migration guide.
Priya: Notifying affected partners and updating support playbook.
Sam: Adding a post-deploy perf regression check scheduled in 2h.
Morgan: All systems stable at +30m. No rollback required. Closing thread. :tada:
